entries.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished landscape 16:9 inventory screen design for the existing Roblox Magnet Workshop Simulator, entirely in Russian. This is a visual concept image, not code. Input image 1 is the actual game context (bright wooden boardwalk, grass, lake, central statue); preserve that artistic atmosphere behind the UI, softly blurred and lightly dimmed. Input image 2 is the approved backpack UI icon; reuse its teal/ivory/honey wood style and recognizable form as a SMALL heading icon. Do not copy the old edge-navigation layout into this modal screen; navigation is hidden while a window is open. Never add a large global game title/status banner.

Design one centered flat, front-facing, implementable game inventory window, approx 80% screen width and 80% height. Premium clean chunky Roblox UI, restrained bevels only, broad ivory panels #F7EEDA, thin warm tan outlines, dark slate typography #2D464B, teal primary buttons #2D999D, small gold accents. Generous spacing. No extravagant ornamental frame, vines, chains or fantasy parchment. Consistent rounded corners and subtle drop shadow. Large clear readable Russian labels, typography drawn cleanly. A compact window heading “Инвентарь”, small backpack icon left, “6 / 24” near heading, small square X button top right. Small corner currency pill “240 монет”, no other persistent HUD.

Left two-thirds: compact tabs “Все”, “Очищенные”, “Ржавые”, then a 3-column × 2-row item card grid. Six unique stylized low-poly salvage item thumbnails: wind-up robot, tin mug, pocket compass, ship bell, road sign, old kick scooter. The compass card selected with a teal outline, other cards neutral. Each card simple, with SHORT Russian item name and small status chip; use names “Робот”, “Кружка”, “Компас”, “Колокол”, “Знак”, “Самокат”. Right one-third: selected item detail pane with a large compass render, heading “Карманный компас”, status “Очищен”, properties “0,2 кг” and “30 монет”; two distinct buttons “На полку” and “Продать”. At bottom of grid a small separate equipment strip showing the current horseshoe magnet + rope, label “Магнит I”, state “В руке”, secondary button “Убрать”. A narrow scroll affordance. No ads, Robux, daily rewards, premium buttons, invented currencies, extra mechanics or watermark. No overlapping text, no technical debug text. All UI functional-looking and aligned, clean readable concept for a real game.
entries.label: Инвентарь
